title: Audience at Outdoor Campus Ceremony, 1966 Mid-Century Snapshot Photo
description: A black-and-white snapshot stamped February 1966 documenting an outdoor public event or ceremony held on a manicured lawn. In the background stands a prominent mid-century modern institutional building with a repetitive grid facade fronted by a covered colonnade, where an audience sits attentively facing a stage or dais. In the foreground, attendees lounge informally on the grass framed by the spindly branches of a leaning tree, capturing the relaxed yet formal atmosphere characteristic of 1960s campus convocations or civic dedications.
